files.attestations.jsonl: DSSE-signed in-toto statements, one per run
files.harness-statements.jsonl: DSSE-signed statements of what the harness measured, signed in segment A, and for a run at a centre what the driver observed there; each attestation cites them by digest
files.ledger.jsonl: every ledger entry, in order, with prev_hash and entry_hash
files.plan.json: the sandbox plan these runs were judged against
files.plans/<digest>.json: every signed plan version, keyed by its digest
files.policies/: network and gate policy files, by name
files.public-keys.json: key id -> PEM, for every key that signed anything here
files.runs/<n>/: each run's logs, whose digests its attestation carries: relay-log.jsonl, model-stdout.log, drop-log.jsonl, job-record.txt, node-config.json

idp_id_tokens.description: the raw OpenID Connect ID token behind each plan or report signature made through an identity provider, kept whole because the IdP's signature covers it; its claims name the signer and say when and how they logged in

staff_identifiers.description: email addresses and identity-provider subject ids of the people who act for the parties: in the plan's roles and processors, and in the ledger entries that record who committed, requested, decided or signed what

personal_data.test_subject_data_basis: none, by construction of the export: no image, no ground-truth label or age, no group label of an item and no item id of any dataset. Results are aggregates by group; the model's decision log gives its output per request, keyed by a random request id that nothing in the bundle links to an item
